metadata.errata_version: Official Errata and Clarifications (as of 31 Aug 2026)
official_errata_applied: Submarine Mats (correction): Junsen J.3 includes Aft Torpedo Doors damage box in Systems Status.
Submarine Mats - Sen-Toku (correction): All 8 tubes are Forward (none aft). Aft torpedo damage hits treated as No Effect.
Submarine Patrol Log (correction): Sen-Toku availability updated to December 1944 (not September 1944).
Submarine Mats - Kaiten Installation (clarification): Conversion occurs automatically on date (typically removes deck gun), but Kaiten carried ONLY on Kaiten missions.
Countersheet (clarification): Daihatsu landing craft counter used on Transport Missions [7.4] as reminder.

Sen_Toku_Class.special_rules:
Availability December 1944. Massive aircraft carrier submarine carrying 3 Aichi M6A1 Seiran bombers.
Armament: All 8 torpedo tubes are Forward; any aft torpedo tube damage hits on Chart [E6] are treated as No Effect. Heavy gun armament with Ammo x6, 4x 25mm Triple AA guns, Mk 3 M1 Air Search and Mk 2 M2 Sea Search Radar.

duplex_print.pairing_logic: Los 2 colosos finales: el superportaviones I-400 y el de alta velocidad.

Sen_Taka_Class.special_rules:
Revolutionary high-speed submarine (19 knots submerged). Streamlined hull, snorkel, high capacity batteries.
• High Speed Underwater: Due to very high underwater speed, this class never gets a +1 modifier for previous detection.
• Electric Motor Hits: Second Electric Motor 1 hit goes against Electric Motor 3; second Electric Motor 2 hit goes against Electric Motor 4. All penalties for electric motor hits on Chart [E3] are reduced by 1.
• Battery Damage: Does not suffer a +1 drm for battery damage until all three have been damaged.

duplex_print.pairing_logic: Los 2 colosos finales: el superportaviones I-400 y el de alta velocidad.
